title: Prisma Security Best Practices
description: Apply security best practices including parameterized queries, input validation, and avoiding raw queries.

data.text: Prisma Client automatically parameterizes queries, protecting you from SQL injection. However, there are still security considerations when building applications with Prisma.

items: All queries are parameterized by default
Input validation should happen before passing data to Prisma
Use `$queryRaw` and `$executeRaw` only when necessary and with validated inputs

data.title: Validating Input
data.content: Validate user input before passing to Prisma.

data.text: Prefer Prisma's query methods over raw queries. When you must use raw queries, always validate and sanitize inputs, and use parameterized queries.

data.title: Security
data.text: Never concatenate user input into raw SQL strings. Use template literal syntax with `$queryRaw` which safely parameterizes values.
